name: Shuutai Youhei
source:
An officer introduced in Shin Koihime Musou. Despite her small size she's a skillful warrior, wielding a sword that's as long as she is tall. She's quite fond of cats. She develops a huge crush on [url=/c204]Kazuto[/url], to the point of blushing profusely when the other members of the Go faction tease her about it.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Koihime_Musō_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
